Next, I'd like to browse the electronics catalog for headphones. Please find the black Sony XM5s with the product ID p_sony_xm5_blk and add them to my cart. I also want to see some recommendations for similar products. From those suggestions, I’ve decided I want the silver Sony XM5s instead, so please put one on hold for me. Go ahead and confirm the order using my credit_card as the payment method, and finally, just provide me with the resulting order ID as a string.
